sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Biocompatible Dental Ceramic Blocks and Milling Discs

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code tradition with EU regulatory overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU), Articles 49-54 (freedom of establishment)
OECD Declaration on International Investment and Multinational Enterprises (national treatment instrument)
France's active network of bilateral investment treaties (BITs) as applicable to specific non-EU investor jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L.561-1 et seq. and R.561-1 et seq., as amended by Ordinance No. 2020-115 and Law No. 2016-1691 (Sapin II); UBO declaration rules under Articles L.561-2-2, L.561-45, L.561-46 and R.561-14 to R.561-23; French Commercial Code, Article L.123-1 et seq. (RCS filing obligations); Decree No. 2014-128 governing UBO declarations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each ultimate beneficial owner/shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national authority in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Apostille countries)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (e.g., utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, with certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate existence certificate and board resolution of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry and notary/public officer of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, with certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney in favor of the French incorporation agent/counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent public authority in the country of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, with certified French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (Decision CFSP), United Nations Security Council sanctions lists, the French national asset-freezing list (gel des avoirs, ACPR/BERcy), and OFAC SDN List to the extent the commercial activity uses USD payment rails or involves US nexus. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) must be identified under EU AML Directive (Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended) and FATF standards; enhanced customer due diligence applies to any PEP, family member, or close associate. Additional enhanced measures are mandated where a trust, shell company, or high-risk third-country structure is identified.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Infogreffe / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) database and Formalités.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Article 2 of the French Constitution and Law No. 94-665 of 4 August 1994 (loi Toubon), all statutory filings, articles of association, and public announcements must be in French. The corporate name must use Latin script; if a foreign name is originally in non-Latin characters, a phonetic transliteration in Latin characters must be adopted. The name must not be contrary to public order, must not mislead the public, and must not improperly appropriate official state terminology or regulated professional titles.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not maintain a formal statutory name-reservation system; the 30-day window denotes the internal validity of the pre-filing availability check and the deadline for submission of formation documents. Upon a refusal by the greffe du tribunal de commerce, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the President of the Tribunal de commerce (référé) within one month of notification, requesting annulment of the refusal. The applicant should attach the refusal notice, the requested name, proof of availability search, and an explanatory memorandum on compliance with public-order and non-misleading requirements. An adverse first-instance decision may be appealed to the Cour d'appel. No administrative extension exists for a name reservation; re-submission through the Guichet unique is required after correction of the grounds of refusal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible. A SARL may have its registered office (siège social) at the residence of the manager, at the office of an approved domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) for a maximum renewable period of five years, or at a physical commercial lease. However, for the regulated manufacture of dental ceramic blocks and milling discs under ISIC 3250, a physical industrial site with real productive substance is legally required; a virtual office cannot replace the ANSM-licenced production facility, storage, quality-control, and traceability infrastructure.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 70% probability within the first 24 months of registration, due to mandatory inspections by the Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des Produits de Santé (ANSM) for medical-device manufacturing and unannounced on-site audits by economic/fiscal enforcement units for VAT, labor, and corporate substance verification.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name availability search and preliminary legal validation (RCS/INPI database, official listing check, trademark collision review)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial court registry (RCS via Infogreffe) and French licensed counsel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration preparation, due diligence, and filing with the Registrar of the Commercial Court
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce / Guichet unique
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff plus counsel's professional fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization or Hague Apostille processing for foreign shareholder KYC bundle (passports, board resolutions, powers of attorney, proof of address)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in origin jurisdiction, French consulate where applicable, and sworn translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official administrative tariffs and prevailing notarial/translation market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translation of constitutional documents and KYC bundle by an expert before a French court (traducteur assermenté)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Judicially recognized tariff per source page (market benchmark)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation contract (three-month advance payment at the approved domiciliation company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Approved third-party domiciliation company (société de domiciliation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of approximately USD 170 per month

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-filing administrative and publication costs for SARL formation (M0 form processing, legal announcement, RCS registration fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce and licensed legal announcement journal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff fixed by French Commercial Code and market advertising rate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL), and Articles R.223-1 to R.223-26 (registration and filing provisions)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) within the territorial jurisdiction of the registered office; filings electronically through the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (GUF)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: M0 Form (Déclaration de création d'une société) filed via the Guichet Unique, together with the completed incorporation formalities package
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for SARL; the articles of association freely determine capital. Paid-up capital must be fully subscribed and, if contributed in cash, deposited with a French bank or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations pending registration, then released upon receipt of the K-bis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the share capital of the Company, as set forth in the Articles of Association, be and is hereby deemed fully subscribed and paid up in accordance with applicable law; (2) that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the address stated in the Articles of Association, with the power in the Manager to transfer it within the same department upon due formalities; (3) that the individual named in the Articles of Association be and is hereby appointed as Manager (Gérant) and acting alone shall represent the Company; (4) that the Manager be authorized to complete all filings, sign all documents, and take all steps necessary to obtain legal personality, corporate registrations, and regulatory licenses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and execute the Articles of Association (Statuts) and append ancillary deeds
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private drafting before any notary; notarial deed required only if contribution consists of real estate or if legal form mandates it. Final filing with Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Guichet Unique.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founders (associés) must draft the Statuts containing the corporate name, registered office address, corporate purpose (including dental CAD/CAM zirconia block manufacturing), share capital, share classes, number of shares, transfer restrictions, management structure, and financial year. Each founder must sign every copy of the Statuts. Supplementary documents include the bank certificate of capital deposit, the declaration of beneficial owner, and the articles (if not notarized). The Manager signs a statement of no criminal convictions and accepts the office. All signatures must be original for paper filings, or authenticated via the Guichet Unique digital platform for electronic submission. If capital contribution is in kind, the auditor's report (commissaire aux apports) must be filed. The entire dossier is transmitted by the Guichet Unique to the Greffe for registration.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association (Statuts) duly dated and signed
Bank certificate of deposit of cash capital (Attestation de dépôt de fonds)
Identity documents of each associate (passport or national ID)
Identity document of the Manager (Gérant)
Declaration of beneficial ownership (Déclaration de bénéficiaire effectif)
Report of the contribution auditor (Rapport du commissaire aux apports), if any in-kind contribution
Statement of non-conviction (Bulletin n°3 equivalent or sworn declaration) for the Manager
Proof of registered office address (utility bill, lease, or domiciliation agreement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a query (demande de pièces complémentaires), the filer must provide the missing or clarified documents via the Guichet Unique within 15 days. If the rejection is based on a substantive legal defect, the Statuts must be amended by unanimous resolution of the associates, and the modified pages must be initialled and re-signed; a new filing submission resets the review window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the incorporation dossier with the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique (online One-Stop Shop) operated by the Direction des Entreprises under the authority of the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), select 'Création de société', enter the SARL business data, upload the Statuts and all required dossiers, fill in the M0 registration form, pay the filing fee electronically, and submit. The system timestamps the filing and transmits it to the competent Greffe. The Greffe verifies legal compliance, the availability of the corporate name, and the domiciliation proof. If approved, the Registry issues the K-bis extract (official corporate identity document) and the SIREN/SIRET numbers. The business becomes a legal person only upon publication of the K-bis.
required_dossiers: Statuts signed by all associates
M0 form (electronic)
Bank capital deposit certificate
Beneficial owner declaration (forme BL_1 or BL_2)
Sworn statement of the Manager accepting office and declaring no incompatibilities
Proof of address of the registered office
Proof of publication of the legal announcement in a journal of legal notices (journal d'annonces légales)
Valid identity documents for all natural persons involved
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guichet returns an error (file incomplete or credentials mismatched), the filer receives a 'demande de régularisation' through the online platform. The filer has 15 business days to upload the corrected document. If the corporate name is already occupied, the founders must propose a new name and file a modified first page of the Statuts. Decisions of refusal may be challenged before the President of the commercial court in accordance with Article L.23-11-1 of the Code de commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish the legal announcement of incorporation in a journal of legal notices
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any accredited legal gazette (Journal d'Annonces Légales) in the department of the registered office, chosen from the official list maintained by the prefecture
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Manager drafts the formal notice containing the corporate name, legal form (SARL), capital, registered office address, corporate purpose, duration, the Manager's name, and the Greffe where registration will be filed. The notice is submitted to the selected gazette with the required publication fee. The gazette issues a certificate / confirmation of publication (attestation de parution) that must be uploaded to the Guichet Unique as part of the M0 filing. The publication must occur before or simultaneously with the registration submission; practical timing permits submission pending the attestation, but the attestation must be provided for registration.
required_dossiers: Text of the legal announcement (avis de constitution)
Proof of payment of the publication fee
Certificate of publication issued by the gazette (attestation de parution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication certificate is not issued due to missing data, the gazette will request corrections; the Manager must submit a corrected announcement text and pay applicable amendment fees. If the gazette refuses publication due to inconsistency with the Statuts, the Statuts must be rectified and re-signed before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain statutory registry extraction (K-bis) and register for social and tax identifiers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; subsequent assignment of SIREN/SIRET, and INSEE; tax registration is automatic through the Guichet Unique transmission to the French tax administration (DGFiP)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approving the complete dossier, the Greffe enters the company into the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), assigns the SIREN (national identification), and issue the K-bis extract as the conclusive proof of incorporation. The Greffe simultaneously notifies INSEE (for SIRET codes) and the tax authority (DGFiP) for automatic VAT and corporate income tax file creation. The Company receives its intra-Community VAT number (if applicable) by separate mailing or through the impots.gouv.fr portal. The Manager must physically collect the K-bis from the Greffe (or download the electronic authenticated version) and verify all data points (name, address, purpose, manager).
required_dossiers: Verification of the K-bis extract after issuance
Confirmation of the SIREN/SIRET numbers from INSEE
Any company data modifications must be reported via the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the K-bis contains a typographical error (e.g., incorrect corporate purpose description), the Manager must file a petition for rectification ('requête en rectification') with the Greffe, furnishing the correct text and the corresponding statutory documentation. If the VAT number does not arrive within 60 days, follow-up with the local business tax office (SIE) is necessary; any delay may be cured through a written application supported by the K-bis.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the beneficial ownership declaration and register the ultimate natural persons
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (receives the declaration); the data is shared with the French State's beneficial ownership database (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The declaration lists each natural person who directly or indirectly holds more than 25% of the capital or voting rights, or who otherwise exercises control over the company. For each beneficial owner, provide civil status, nationality, date and place of birth, residential address, and the exact percentage held. The declaration form (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) is submitted electronically as part of the M0 incorporation form; any subsequent change must be declared within 30 days. The Greffe verifies coherence with the share register.
required_dossiers: Identity documentation of each beneficial owner
Detailed shareholding breakdown demonstrating percentage and control
The signed declaration of beneficial ownership (form BL_1/BL_2)
Proof of ownership chain if intermediate legal entities exist
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe rejects the declaration due to incomplete data, the Company receives a query ticket. The Company must resubmit the revised declaration within 15 days. Failure to provide accurate beneficial owner data may lead to administrative fines and suspension of registration; court action can be initiated for unjustified rejection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités (DREETS) for industrial operating authorization, and the local Mayor's office (Mairie) for ICPE permitting, together with the Agence Régionale de Santé (ARS) where health-related manufacturing standards apply
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificat d'Exploitant / Autorisation d'Exploitation d'Établissement Recevant des Activités de Fabrication — where required under the Code de l'environnement as an Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) for machining of ceramic blocks (rubrique 2430 or 2535 as applicable); additionally, a Manufacturing Operating Permit under the French Public Health Code (Code de la santé publique) if products are considered medical devices

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique, de l'Énergie, du Climat et de la Prévention des Risques (via the Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement – DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For a dental CAD/CAM zirconia block mill/production facility with non-hazardous machining, the installation is likely a 'Déclaration' (registration) regime under ICPE rubrique 2430 or potentially 'Enregistrement' for certain mechanical and dust-generating processes; no full EIA report is generally required unless the plant capacity triggers a higher threshold or is situated in a sensitive zone; an initial environmental assessment screening (examen au cas par cas) may be mandated if the installation exceeds the project threshold set by the French Environmental Code.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to sanitary sewer must comply with local municipal discharge permits (arrêté d'autorisation de déversement) and the general ICPE requirements of Code de l'environnement, Articles R.512-52 to R.512-67; VOC emissions must remain below the limit values set by the European Industrial Emissions Directive transposed in the Code de l'environnement (arrêté du 2 février 1998) and the CTM (Concentrations et Flux) thresholds for hazardous substances; dust emissions from machining must be controlled via filtration to outdoor limits typically ≤ 50 mg/m3, with dry waste (zirconia blocks) classified as non-hazardous industrial waste and handled under a waste tracking obligation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance (Commission de sécurité) is required for the building occupancy category ('ERP' if any public access; 'IGH' if tall building); otherwise, a fire safety attestation from the local fire brigade (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours, SDIS) for industrial establishments must be obtained prior to commissioning. Structural load inspections are carried out by a qualified bureau de contrôle (e.g., SOCOTEC, Bureau Veritas) to confirm floor loads for heavy milling machines. Occupational health clearance documents include the Company's risk assessment (Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques - DUER), the workplace medical inspection validated by the occupational physician (médecin du travail), and, if employees are exposed to ceramic dust, an atmospheric monitoring protocol meeting the workplace limit values (VLEP, e.g., 8-hr TWA for silica respirable fractions). The civil defense clearance is evidenced by the SDIS visit report and the certificate of structural compliance issued by the building controller after installation of equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP); official portal: impots.gouv.fr; one-stop business registration: INPI Guichet Unique; customs export administration: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a French SARL: (1) file incorporation through the INPI Guichet Unique; (2) DGFiP allocates the SIREN/SIRET and the French VAT intracommunity number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) directly after registration; (3) open a professional tax e-filing account on impots.gouv.fr and submit the initial corporate income tax and VAT declarations. For a non-established foreign supplier without a French branch, apply to the DGFiP Service des Impôts des Entreprises Étrangères using the official VAT identification application, providing foreign tax residence proof, constitutional documents, and evidence of French taxable activity; non-EU suppliers normally must appoint a French tax representative authorized by DGFiP.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not operate a check-the-box regime. A French SARL is default taxed as a resident company at entity level (impôt sur les sociétés) on worldwide profits. A narrow election exists under CGI article 239 bis AA permitting certain qualifying SARLs to be taxed like partnerships for a limited period, without creating full transparency for foreign tax purposes. ATAD hybrid mismatch rules are transposed in CGI articles 212 bis and 212 ter and disallow deduction / non-inclusion outcomes from hybrid instruments, branches, or disregarded entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, harmonised under EU Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Non-resident or non-established foreign suppliers: no turnover threshold; any French taxable supply triggers VAT registration unless the reverse-charge mechanism applies. Domestic small-business franchise thresholds: EUR 85,000 for sales of goods and EUR 37,500 for services, with EUR 93,500 and EUR 41,250 tolerance ceilings respectively. Zero-rated export turnover does not count toward these thresholds, and the operating French SARL should normally register to recover input VAT on production costs and claim export VAT refunds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France has introduced mandatory structural e-invoicing and e-reporting. B2B e-invoicing is phased from 1 September 2026 for large and medium enterprises and from 1 September 2027 for small and micro enterprises. Invoices must be exchanged through a DGFiP-registered Dematerialisation Platform (PDP) or Partner Platform (PPF) using Factur-X, UBL, or CII formats; B2G invoices are transmitted through Chorus Pro. Invoice data, payment statuses, and cross-border B2C transaction data must be reported to the DGFiP central tax hub in near real time through platform APIs. There is no per-invoice fiscal stamping in the Italian model, but the absence of compliant transmission or platform acceptance blocks the recipient's VAT deduction.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A French SARL may apply the export zero rate under CGI article 262-I-1° and EU VAT article 146 to dental zirconia blocks physically dispatched or transported to a destination outside the EU. The goods must actually leave the EU customs territory and be supported by compliant export evidence retained by the supplier. The zero rate applies to the sale of goods, whether transport is arranged by the French seller, the foreign buyer, or a third party, provided the export is completed within the statutory period and is evidenced by the export customs declarations. Services directly connected to exported goods or performed for foreign recipients may also fall outside French VAT scope under B2B place-of-supply rules in CGI articles 259, 259 A, and 259 C.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane / DAU or ENS) electronically lodged and released through DGDDI
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, CMR consignment note, or multimodal transport document evidencing movement to a non-EU destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment/proceeds statement evidencing receipt and repatriation of export proceeds
Commercial invoice, packing list, and description of the dental ceramic goods with HS/CN classification
Proof of physical exit from the EU (customs exit verification, GAC/ICS export tracking, vessel/aircraft/crossing manifests)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The export zero-rating remains valid only if the SARL retains a complete, chronological export dossier and reconciles it with VAT returns and customs manifests. The DGFiP may verify export records and retrospectively claw back VAT recovered or deemed exempt if the evidence is missing, internally inconsistent, or fails to prove exit from the EU within the required timeline. Reassessment carries default interest at 0.20% per month, with penalties of 40% for deliberate underdeclaration and 80% for abusive manoeuvres or fraudulent intent. Fictitious exports, forged documents, or fraudulent export VAT credit laundering can trigger criminal sanctions, seizure of goods and bank accounts, substantial fines, and disqualification penalties. Each shipment must therefore be fully documented and export proceeds repatriated within the 180-day compliance window.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (BdF) and Direction Générale du Trésor, with banking supervision delegated to the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies full convertibility for both current and capital account transactions under EU free movement of capital rules. No general FX licence is required and profit remittance in the form of dividends is permitted without exchange control approval. Non-EU direct investment and capital movements are subject to balance-of-payments reporting to the Banque de France; dividend and trade payments are settled freely through resident banks. No material profit repatriation hurdle exists beyond standard corporate law distribution tests, anti-money laundering documentary diligence, and tax withholding declarations where applicable.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export proceeds surrender obligation or mandatory conversion ratio in France. Exporters may retain proceeds in foreign currency accounts and are not required to repatriate or convert receipts into EUR. Balances must nevertheless be declared for balance-of-payments statistical purposes under Banque de France reporting instructions, and cross-border movements exceeding regulatory thresholds must be reported by the resident bank or declared by the exporter within the applicable deadline.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low rate of viability for offshore digital EMI providers. A non-EU/EEA electronic money institution may not operate in France without an ACPR authorisation or a valid passport from its EU home state. Use of unlicensed offshore EMIs to hold SARL funds or issue French IBANs creates regulatory, tax and payment-settlement risk. A licensed French or EEA EMI, such as a separately regulated fintech with a Banque de France clearing account, is more viable but remains subordinate to a full commercial bank for trade-finance and documentary credit services.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors is generally not a legal prerequisite under French AML/KYC rules. Remote onboarding is permitted through ACPR-compatible video identity verification and electronic signature, provided the bank uses a secure validation process and obtains original or certified identification documents. In practice, for a newly formed SARL with non-resident directors and a manufacturing/trading profile, banks commonly request at least one video conference or physical meeting with the legal representative and ultimate beneficial owners to corroborate business activity and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner with opaque ownership layers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passports, a French or apostilled incorporation certificate, full AML-consistent organisational chart identifying each shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner, statutory financial projections, proof of registered address, notarised board minutes appointing the representative, and a clear commercial narrative for manufacturing dental ceramics in France.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high transaction velocity or unusual overseas counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed commercial contracts, pro-forma invoices, supplier/end-customer due diligence files, customs and import-export declarations, ISO and CE/CNEDIM documentation for dental zirconia products, and a documented treasury and payment workflow explaining trade-related flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically exposed person or sanctions/embargo screening flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed source-of-wealth declaration, confirmation of non-PEP status or lawful PEP disclosure with supporting justification, residency and business certificates, comprehensive sanctions/embargo screening evidence, and an undertaking to comply with all EU and French restrictive measures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bank branch policy requiring minimum operational history and investor/business documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified bank statements of shareholder injection funds, audited or accountant-prepared opening balance sheet, lease agreement for the French registered office, insurance certificates, SARL statutory announcements, and a formal five-year business plan covering capacity, sales channels, and repatriation of profits.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions must be initiated as a SWIFT MT103 (or equivalent SEPA wire for EUR) to the SARL's Euro-denominated account using the French IBAN. The payment message should carry the corporate legal name, likely-to-match account details, and a purpose code designating a share capital contribution or a shareholder loan, such as 'Capital contribution' or 'Financial investment' for the Banque de France balance-of-payments declaration. The remitting bank is required to include the underlying beneficiary shareholder's identity and the transaction rationale. For direct investments from outside the EU, the resident bank or the SARL must comply with Banque de France reporting thresholds and maintain supporting legal documentation including the convertible-bond or capital-increase instrument, funds-source proof, and tax declaration references.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement of imports of raw materials and export-related payments shall be made through the resident operation account using SWIFT MT103 messages, recommending EUR settlement via SEPA Credit Transfer where the counterpart carefully validates the French IBAN and BIC. For high-value or documentary transactions, a commercial letter of credit (L/C) issued subject to UCP600 from a French confirming bank is the preferred clearing rail, supported by bills of exchange, collection orders, and export invoices. Real-time gross settlement in the euro area uses TARGET2; SWIFT-based messaging and the bank's compliance filtering will verify payment purpose, beneficiary beneficial-owner details, and export-contract consistency before release.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD or EUR/CNY forward contracts with a licensed French or EEA credit institution
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) with notional reference to emerging-market currencies where regular physical settlement is unavailable
Cross-currency swap for matching committed supply chain cash flows in EUR and foreign currency
Vanilla European-style FX options for hedging contingent export or import exposure
FX spot and forward combinations executed only for hedging genuine commercial exposure under EMIR reporting obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (comptes annuels) and liasse fiscale (tax package) deposited with the commercial registry (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (commercial court registry) via the Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after shareholder approval, and approval no later than six months after the financial year-end; calendar-year SARL therefore by 30 June for approval and 31 July for deposit.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil fine up to EUR 7,500 for legal persons (EUR 1,500 for individuals), coercive daily fines (astreinte) after formal notice, and risk of administrative strike-off (radiation from RCS) after repeated non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (French beneficial-ownership register maintained within the RCS filing system)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the annual accounts deposit each year; any change in beneficial ownership (including share transfers) must be declared within 30 days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EUR 1,000 for natural persons and EUR 5,000 for legal persons for missing or false declarations; criminal penalties may apply in cases of intentional concealment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax returns (déclaration de résultats n°2065 and supporting schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - Local Business Tax Office (Service des Impôts des Entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar financial year: second working day after 1 May (3 May in a non-shifted year) for paper filers and 15 May for mandatory online filers.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% per month of the final tax liability (capped at 10%) and 10% after formal notice, plus monthly 1.5% statutory interest; fixed EUR 1,500 fines for incomplete schedules.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit (commissaire aux comptes) if the SARL exceeds at least two of: balance-sheet total EUR 4,000,000; net turnover exclusive of VAT EUR 8,000,000; average workforce 50 employees. Below these thresholds, shareholders representing at least 10% of capital may request an expert review or audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, PCG) under Articles L.123-12 et seq. of the French Commercial Code; IFRS is permitted only for consolidated accounts of listed or public-interest groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At least once each calendar year, the managing director must reconfirm the registered beneficial-ownership data at the time of the annual accounts filing; any share transfer that modifies the shareholder composition or crosses the 25% or voting-control threshold must be entered in the securities register and declared to the RCS within 30 days. A nil-change confirmation is required if no ownership has changed.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of Directors and Managers (Registre des délibérations et décisions)
Minute Book (Feuilles de présence et procès-verbaux des assemblées générales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,000 - USD 2,500 per year for registered-office/domiciliation and legal mail handling in metropolitan France.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - USD 10,000 per year for a statutory audit of a small-to-mid-sized SARL, depending on group structure, inventory complexity, and internal controls.
